tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The rates quoted by the bidders in the price sheet should not less than the minimum wages as per the minimum wages act.
The annual contract price is computed for a period of 12 months from the date of providing services for the award of contract.
The Bidder shall quote the Man power and material separately.

The nature of House Keeping Services is as per the terms and conditions as noted in the tender schedule file which shall be read carefully and agencies that are capable of carrying out the House Keeping Services as per the above conditions need apply.
The amount put to tender is for the House Keeping Services for period of 12 Months. The successful bidder may claim the monthly bills at the rate of 1/12th of amount quoted for 12 Months.
The rates quoted shall include provision of payment of EPF, ESI and GST etc if applicable.
No materials will be supplied departmentally. The Bidder has to make his own arrangement for procurement of required materials.
The Bids shall remain valid for a period of 90 days from the date of opening of Bid.
Conditional Bid is liable for rejection without assigning any reasons.

The successful Bidder shall bind himself to abide by the rules and specifications in force and shall execute the necessary agreement on stamp paper within seven days from the date of intimation of acceptance of his Bid, failing which, his Bid will be cancelled unconditionally and his EMD will be forfeited. In addition they would also be responsible for making good the extra expenditure that would be incurred in inviting fresh Bids for the Work.
The EMD of the successful bidder will be refunded soon after the agreement is executed. Security deposit will be refunded only after the completion of the service period.
The service should not be sub-let.
The EMD furnished by the unsuccessful bidders will be refunded only after entrustment of the work to the successful Bidder or after completion of validity period of tenders.

The Bidder has to pay compensation to the disabled or deceased workmen under him for any injury or death caused during the execution of works, failing which the necessary amount will be deducted from the bills and paid to the injured or deceased.
BESCOM reserves the right to reject or accept any of the tenders without assigning any reasons.
For more details, refer attached NIT.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Agency should have provided similar services satisfactorily for at least one reputed Organization like Bank, MNCs, PSUs, Defence establishments, Govt organizations (State/Central), Electrical Distribution/Transmission Company etc., for a period of atleast One year in the preceding 03 Financial years for not less than 7 persons. The performance Certificates from such Organization shall be scanned in originals and uploaded. Work completion/performance certificates issued by the respective departments not below the rank of the Executive Engineer/ equivalent officer in charge of respective works shall be scanned and uploaded.

The bidder shall be registered under GST, Workmen Compensation Act with the competent Authority and the following valid registration certificates/records shall be uploaded along with the bid. Pan card.
The agency shall be an assesse under Income Tax Act. Copies of the last three years IT returns shall be uploaded along with relevant annexure.

The Annual turnover during any one of the preceding three financial years i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 shall not be two times (Rs. 96.40 Lakhs) of the amount put to tender. Audited Turnover certificate from Chartered accountant along with UDIN must be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Profit and loss account & balance sheets audited by Chartered Accountant of preceding three financial years i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Profit loss statements and Balance sheets

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall upload Banker's Certificate pertaining to Liquid Assets not less than Rs. 14,46,000.00 (30% of amount put to tender) for the housekeeping service. The Bankers certificate should be in enclosed format OR As per Balance Sheet issued by the Chartered Accountant, the Cash on Hand + Cash at Bank + Term Deposits in any Indian Nationalized/Scheduled Commercial Bank during 2025-26 should not be less than Rs. 14,46,000.00.

The agency should have valid registration certificate under Manpower agency. The bidder has to submit registration certificate of establishment i.e., Form C issued by the Labour department of Government of Karnataka and it should be in force duly indicating period of validity and nature of business should be Manpower Services

The Bidder should not have been Blacklisted/Defaulted in any of the ESCOMS/KPTCL/KPCL and other Government Electrical utilities in Central/State Government or Public Sector undertakings in India on the date of bid opening. Self-declaration shall be uploaded. (Declaration letter has to be Notarized in the stamp paper of value Rs. 100
